source_description: Mayfield Trojans vs Centennial Hawks high-school basketball; PlayOn public sample for computer-vision and ML proof-of-concept development.

selection.reason: Different match and source from the original ten Celtics/Knicks tutorial clips. Selected before running any models, after visual inspection only. Free throws in roughly first half followed by live full-court transitions. Earlier 20-minute candidate rejected because it mostly showed a quarter-end timeout.
selection.uniforms: white with dark green trim versus dark burgundy/black with yellow trim
selection.camera: Elevated sideline broadcast camera; pans across both halves; six-sample contact sheet showed no obvious editorial cut.

processing: Video stream copied, no image rescaling or frame-rate conversion; audio omitted. FFmpeg reported a source HLS timestamp discontinuity and corrected it. Saved MP4 subsequently passed full decoded-frame count without decoding errors.
rights_note: The publisher explicitly offers this sample HLS stream for downloading and computer-vision proof-of-concept development. The inspected repository has no separately stated open-content license. This record is provenance, not a grant to redistribute the video; retain locally for benchmarking and publish source links plus derived timing results rather than bundling footage.
benchmark_limitations: High-school court geometry differs from the NBA geometry assumed by our court mapper; report calibration coverage and do not treat this as court-accuracy validation.
Uniform colors differ from the original Celtics/Knicks demo; current hardcoded color classification may not transfer.
This is a fresh timing workload, not a model-accuracy benchmark with ground-truth annotations.
